title: Head office: a real tower and lobby, Kuro at reception
caption: The lift no longer stands alone: head office is a 12-storey tower east of the station, where the island map puts it, with a lobby round the lifts. Kuro now works its reception.

sections.title: Before
sections.caption: The old lobby box with the lift, a background-coloured roof beside it and a small tower behind.

sections.title: Outside
sections.caption: From the station door the tower and the canopy with 本社 HEAD OFFICE are on the right; walking east brings the whole front into view.

sections.title: Lobby
sections.caption: Inside, the floors above fade so the lobby shows: reception with Kuro, the B2 lift, a closed 6F-10F lift, the stairs and the floor directory.

sections.title: The lift and the evening walk out
sections.caption: The ride is filmed as before. After work he comes up into the lobby, and the tower comes back, lit, as he steps out of the door.

sections.title: On the island map
sections.caption: The built tower from above sits on the map's head office outline.
